answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral and treats synchronized equivocation as correlated evidence: when k identities coordinate, aggregate penalties grow as O(k^2), not linearly. Detection then applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the implicated swarm, with asymmetric depreciation making unrecoverable stake dominate any temporary gain. A whisper-level delta in timing can still expose a sable-colored coordination pattern.
